text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I'll shine brighter than anyone, and I'll
leave
more of a mark than anyone else.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (So keep your eyes on me, everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (On me... and only me!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: YAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-whoa! It's Machan—Aston Machan
won!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't take my eyes off her!
I-I forgot
to even
breathe!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Geez, my eyes welled up when she
crossed the
finish line... Machan's just
plain amazing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Last year was incredible. I still
remember it
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking right at me,
clapping and
cheering with smiles on
their faces.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: But this... This is even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can see myself in their eyes... I'm
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: They're focusing on Machan.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the unforgettable race,
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see your next race!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aston Machan. You remember me
now, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Yay!
